name: lens-local-search
title: Lens
description: Find local files by meaning, with private on-device search and optional decision-model guidance.
author: justus_august

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files by Meaning
commands.subtitle: Lens
commands.description: Find photos, documents, audio, video and code with local semantic search.

preferences.name: decisionProvider
preferences.title: Decision Model
preferences.description: Interprets your search and optionally guides candidate ranking. Select a provider and its key. Reopen Search after changing settings.

preferences.name: decisionMetadata
preferences.title: Decision Model Sharing
preferences.description: Contents, previews, OCR, embeddings and folder paths always stay local. Candidate ranking uses up to 12 files. Provider retention policies apply.

preferences.name: subqApiKey
preferences.title: SubQ API Key
preferences.description: Used only for this provider. Shared fields follow Decision Model Sharing above. Files and index stay local.

preferences.name: jevApiKey
preferences.title: Jev API Key
preferences.description: Used only for this provider. Shared fields follow Decision Model Sharing above. Files and index stay local.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Used only for this provider. Shared fields follow Decision Model Sharing above. Files and index stay local.

preferences.name: localDecisionURL
preferences.title: Local Model URL
preferences.description: For Local Model only. OpenAI-compatible server on this Mac, such as LM Studio (port 1234) or Ollama (port 11434). Include /v1.

preferences.name: localDecisionModel
preferences.title: Local Model Name
preferences.description: For Local Model only. Model name from your local server; blank uses its first reported model. Your server may load it into memory.

preferences.name: localContentRanking
preferences.title: Local Content Ranking
preferences.label: Check the best candidates on this Mac
preferences.description: Requires the optional 2.66 GB model: download it from Actions in Choose Search Folders. Uses a small local shortlist and releases the model afterward. File contents stay local. Reopen Search after changing.

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Choose Search Folders
commands.subtitle: Lens
commands.description: Choose local folders for files, media and code. No separate app is required.

commands.name: index-files
commands.title: Update Search Index
commands.subtitle: Lens
commands.description: Keep chosen folders indexed automatically every five minutes, or update them now.

commands.name: review-scope
commands.title: Review Automatic Exclusions
commands.subtitle: Lens
commands.description: Review automatically omitted project copies and tool snapshots, or restore them to the index. No files are deleted.
